_about: Numbers cited by the wifi-csi-sensing kit. Every entry has 'class' = 'public' (a public standard, paper, vendor document, or physics arithmetic on public values; the source says which) or 'illustrative' (a round value of the same order of magnitude as an internal study figure, invented to teach a relation; never a measurement). No internal measurement is reproduced. Internal source tags I1-I7 are described generically in SOURCES.md. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.

ofdm_symbol_11a_n_ac.source: IEEE 802.11 OFDM PHY, long guard interval

beamforming_grouping_ng.source: IEEE 802.11n/ac compressed beamforming feedback, grouping parameter Ng

nonoverlapping_channels_2g4.source: IEEE 802.11 2.4 GHz channel plan; channel centres 5 MHz apart, 20 MHz wide

beacon_rate_default.source: my arithmetic from beacon_interval_default: 1 / (100 x 1024 us)

wavelength_5g.source: my arithmetic: speed_of_light / 5.5 GHz (mid 5 GHz band)

delay_resolution_by_width.unit: ns and metres of path length
delay_resolution_by_width.source: my arithmetic: delay resolution = 1/bandwidth; path = speed_of_light x delay

fresnel_first_zone_mid_radius_example.source: my arithmetic: r1 = 0.5 x sqrt(lambda x d) at the midpoint of a link of illustrative length d = 4 m (link_length_illustrative); formula from Fresnel-zone model, Wang et al. UbiComp 2016

doppler_walk_example_5g.source: my arithmetic: reflected path length changes at up to 2 x 1 m/s for an illustrative 1 m/s walk; f = 2 / wavelength_5g

intel5300_csi_groups.source: Halperin, Hu, Sheth, Wetherall, 'Tool release: gathering 802.11n traces with channel state information', SIGCOMM CCR 41(1), 2011

atheros_csi_subcarriers.source: Xie, Li, Li, 'Precise power delay profiling with commodity WiFi', MobiCom 2015 (Atheros CSI Tool)

esp32_csi_lltf_subcarriers.source: Espressif ESP-IDF programming guide, Wi-Fi driver, 'Wi-Fi Channel State Information'

hampel_mad_scale.source: Hampel filter / MAD consistency constant for Gaussian data (Pearson, IEEE Trans. Control Syst. Technol. 2002)

hampel_threshold_typical.source: conventional Hampel threshold (Pearson 2002; MATLAB hampel default)

triplet_margin_facenet.unit: squared L2 distance on unit-norm embeddings

mimo_2x2_streams.source: my arithmetic: 2 TX x 2 RX antennas

link_length_illustrative.source: round room-scale link length used for the Fresnel example in A1

csi_rate_beacon_illustrative.source: round value for passive beacon-driven CSI; consistent with beacon_rate_default; internal I2/I7 report the same order

csi_rate_injected_illustrative.source: round nominal rate with injected traffic (pings or test frames); internal I7 reports the same order

actual_vs_nominal_rate_illustrative.source: illustrative spread of achieved CSI rate around nominal across two chips; internal I7 hardware comparison

outlier_ratio_illustrative.source: illustrative 'a few percent' outlier range; internal I7 chipset comparison

parse_error_2g4_illustrative.source: illustrative order of CSI parsing errors on the congested 2.4 GHz band at high rate; internal I7

window_short_illustrative.source: round analysis window used in early single-link work; internal I1/I2

window_long_illustrative.source: round analysis window used in later feature studies; internal I7
